/products/polybag/.title: polybag
/products/polybag/.short_description: Polybags use lightweight flexible film in clear or printed formats with heat-sealed or twist-tie closures, making them practical for bread, pasta, bagels, tea, cookies, and other products that benefit from compact presentation and visible contents.

/products/stand-up-pouch/.title: Stand Up Pouch
/products/stand-up-pouch/.short_description: Stand up pouches combine an upright gusseted base, laminated exterior, and shelf-ready front panel for chocolates, confectionery, wellness products, tea, prepared foods, and other premium dry goods.

/products/flat-bottom-pouch/.title: Flat Bottom Pouch
/products/flat-bottom-pouch/.short_description: Flat bottom pouches use a reinforced rectangular base and side gussets to create a stable box-style profile that suits coffee, snacks, nuts, seeds, grains, detergent powders, and other premium or bulk dry products.

/products/retort-pouch/.title: Retort Pouch
/products/retort-pouch/.short_description: High-temperature resistant pouches for sterilized food products with extended shelf life.

/products/spout-pouch/.title: Spout Pouch
/products/spout-pouch/.short_description: Convenient pouches with integrated spouts for liquid and semi-liquid products.

/products/roll-stock-films/.title: Roll Stock Films
/products/roll-stock-films/.short_description: Roll stock films provide continuous printed flexible film for automated form-fill-seal and wrapping lines, supporting pillow packs, flow wraps, sachets, snack packs, and other high-volume converted packaging formats.

/products/stand-up-pouch-tap/.title: Stand Up Pouch with Tap
/products/stand-up-pouch-tap/.short_description: Large format pouches with dispensing taps, ideal for bag-in-box applications.

/products/bag-in-box/.title: Bag In Box
/products/bag-in-box/.short_description: Inner bags designed for box packaging, perfect for beverages and liquid products.

/products/quad-seal-bag/.title: Quad Seal Bag
/products/quad-seal-bag/.short_description: Four-corner sealed bags offering maximum shelf impact and filling capacity.

/products/flat-pouch/.title: Flat Pouch
/products/flat-pouch/.short_description: Simple three-side sealed pouches for sachets, samples, and lightweight products.

/products/shaped-pouch/.title: Shaped Pouch
/products/shaped-pouch/.short_description: Custom die-cut pouches in unique shapes for standout shelf presence.

/products/pinch-bottom-pouches/.title: Pinch Bottom Pouches
/products/pinch-bottom-pouches/.short_description: Pinch bottom pouches feature a folded reinforced base, structured side gussets, and broad print panels for rice, coffee, tea, dried fruit, pet food, and other high-volume dry goods that need stable upright presentation.

/products/stand-up-pouch/premium-almonds.title: Premium Almonds Window Stand-Up Pouch
/products/stand-up-pouch/premium-almonds.short_description: A refined cream and maroon almond pouch made for premium nuts, roasted almonds, dry fruits, and healthy snack ranges. The die-cut window, resealable zipper, and upright structure create a natural retail look while helping customers clearly see the almonds inside.
/products/stand-up-pouch/premium-almonds.seo_title: Premium Almonds Window Stand-Up Pouch | Custom Nut Packaging
/products/stand-up-pouch/premium-almonds.seo_description: Premium custom almond pouch with a transparent window, resealable zipper, bottom gusset, and custom printing for almonds, nuts, dry fruits, and healthy snack packaging.

/products/stand-up-pouch/cotton-candy-pa.title: Cotton Candy Pastel Pink Hanging Pouch
/products/stand-up-pouch/cotton-candy-pa.short_description: A soft pastel hanging pouch designed for cotton candy, candy floss, party treats, and lightweight sweet products. The pink background, cotton candy artwork, and hang hole display create a cheerful pack for kids, events, and novelty retail displays.

/products/stand-up-pouch/frozen-candied-.title: Frozen Candied Grapes Atomic Sourberry Hanging Pouch
/products/stand-up-pouch/frozen-candied-.short_description: A dramatic dark hanging pouch created for sour berry candy, frozen-style candied grapes, and bold novelty confectionery. High-contrast artwork, splash graphics, and a built-in hang hole give the pack a strong, energetic shelf personality.
